phase_name: Red-first regression tests for the three acceptance shapes

objectives.description: Read test-git-commit-scoped.sh in full; reuse build_repo/run_commit/pass/fail/info patterns
Add T8 - deletion-only scoped commit case
Add T9 - deletion mixed with modification case
Run suite against unpatched script, capture red evidence for T8/T9/T10
objectives.note: T1-T7 PASS, T8/T9/T10 FAIL as predicted: T8 hits V3 post-filter refusal (rc=2, zero positive pathspecs after filtering); T9 commits only the modification (deletion dropped, WARN emitted, D file.txt left staged, status not clean); T10 commits only the add half of the rename (WARN dropping the delete-half pathspec, D file.txt left staged).

Two pre-existing SC2329 false-positive warnings on info()/cleanup() (unused-in-file / trap-invoked) fixed with disable directives + rationale comments so the file is fully shellcheck-clean; unrelated to the T8-T10 additions themselves, which introduced zero new warnings.
